link_congestion.json.description: Hostel distribution uplink saturates; latency rises with load downstream.

weak_wifi.json.description: One hostel AP has poor signal; wired PC on the same switch is fine.

interface_fault.json.description: CSE department switch port: CRC and interface errors rising, link flapping.

dns_failure.json.description: DNS resolver failing while the network path is healthy.

dhcp_failure.json.description: DHCP pool exhausted; new clients cannot get addresses.

device_overload.json.description: Core switch CPU and memory exhausted, interfaces clean.

wan_latency.json.description: Latency spike on the upstream path with no local congestion.

upstream_outage.json.description: Hostel distribution switch silent; everything below it unreachable.

conflicting_wifi_vs_congestion.json.description: Hostel AP shows a borderline signal, but the access switch is saturated and the wired PC is slow too: agents must decide between Wi-Fi and congestion.

monitoring_gap.json.description: DEPT_SW_01 sends no telemetry, but every device below it is healthy: a monitoring gap, not an outage.

no_topology.json.description: Hostel congestion, but no topology supplied: diagnosis per device, scope undetermined.

interop_legacy_mixed.json.description: Legacy collector: camelCase names, seconds, fractions, epoch times, unit strings, a record without a device id, an out-of-range CPU value, plus findings from two external agents (one valid legacy 0.9 message, one malformed).

malformed_json.txt.description: Broken JSON: must fail with a clear message, not a crash.

organiser_stream.ndjson.description: Organiser-format NDJSON stream (5 samples) with one corrupted line.
